comparison.objective: Stretch an O-ring over threads and seat it untwisted in a groove; candidate removes a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual elastic stretching, clearing threads, and twist control versus rigid fine-tool insertion and low-force extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Ring seated square, untwisted, and not overstretched versus reusable terminal and housing after removal. Candidate limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Deformable seal installation tests different contact physics and abilities.
